Clinic: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms; open 08:00–19:00 weekdays, 09:00–13:00 Saturday. Twelve nurses (three shifts) plus four admin staff. Accreditation runs to April 2027; renewal needs an infection-control audit.

Attendance averages 180/day, peaking at 310 (January 2025 flu wave). No-shows fell from 14% to 9% after September 2024 reminder texts.

Key incidents: a March 2024 vaccine fridge failure (€2,100 lost) led to a networked alarm plus paper log; a November 2024 concurrent record edit overwrote an allergy field, so records now lock when open.

Rules: no prescription renewal without a consultation within 12 months; vaccine stock counted twice weekly; temperature excursions above 8°C reported same day.

A second ultrasound was postponed pending an unstarted utilisation study. The nursing coordinator post has been vacant since August 2025, covered rotationally by two senior nurses—unsustainable beyond winter.
